content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the THSTI SIB Fellow Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 23-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of THSTI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the THSTI SIB (Biodesign) Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the THSTI SIB (Biodesign) Fellow recruitment is 23rd September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the SIB (Biodesign) Fellow post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the SIB (Biodesign) Fellow position by THSTI.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc./Ph.D. in Life Sciences/Chemistry, B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech, MBBS/BDS/BVSc, Master's in Product/Industrial Design, or an MBA with a Life Science/Engineering background.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the SIB (Biodesign) Fellow post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the SIB (Biodesign) Fellow position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 60,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the THSTI recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 590/- for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 118/- for SC/ST and Women candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the SIB (Biodesign) Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves screening of applications, followed by a personal interview at THSTI Faridabad, with the final selection based on interview performance.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a government job or a contractual position?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position at BRIC Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI).

faq.question: Q9. Where is the THSTI located?
faq.answer: THSTI is located in Faridabad, Haryana, with the pincode 121001.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the THSTI SIB (Biodesign) Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official THSTI website on or before the last date, following the instructions provided in the 'How to Apply' section.
